notes.title: Operation Beta Test Complete — The Ultimate Mech War Goes Live on July 31!
notes.content: [p]Commanders,[/p][p]The beta test officially ended on July 7 at 24:00 (UTC-4). As the servers are now closed, your expedition on Milkhama Island has come to an end for the time being. Thanks for taking part! [/p][p]We received an overwhelming amount of thoughtful feedback during the beta, and we can't thank you enough for believing in Mecharashi and sharing your insights. Our next step is to carefully review every detail and continue refining the game to deliver the best experience possible. [/p][p]Mecharashi launches globally on July 31. When it does, Milkhama Island becomes the stage for true tactical warfare. Where will its story take you next? We look forward to welcoming you back to the island![/p]

notes.title: SteamNextFest Demo Coming on June 9th
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491754/284df032990fcbb166110207a15e5bafdc57b137.jpg"][/img]Greetings, Commander! [/p][p]We've just released the first playable PC demo—download it and start playing today! While we're excited for you to start exploring the intricate game world of Mecharashi for yourselves, we've also prepared a short FAQ below so you can find the answers to some of the most commonly asked questions in one place.
[/p][p]*Please note that this is a development-stage build, and certain features are unfinished. As such, you may experience the following issues:[/p][p]Certain text may overflow UI boundaries, certain translations may be imprecise, and various elements are still undergoing optimization.[/p][p]These issues will be fixed by the time the official release rolls around, and the game will also include a deeper story, tougher battles, and a richer, more immersive audiovisual experience. Thanks for sticking with us and showing your support![/p][p][/p][p]About the Demo | FAQ[/p][p]Q: What's in the demo?[/p][p]A: The demo includes up to 6 hours of single-player story content, offering an early look into the world of Mecharashi ahead of its full release.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Which languages are available in the demo?[/p][p]A: English is available across the entire demo, including UI, subtitles, and character voiceover. In the full release, more localization options will be available.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: How much will the game cost?[/p][p]A: Mecharashi will be free-to-play on all platforms.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Will I get to carry my demo progress over to the full game when it launches?[/p][p]A: Progress made in the demo version will not carry over to the release version.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Can I record content from the demo and share it on social media?[/p][p]A: Absolutely! Whether you're a content creator or just love to share, feel free to show the world your experiences in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: If I encounter any bugs while playing the demo, how can I report them?[/p][p]A: Join our Discord server and head to the #steam-demo channel to report any bugs you find. Suggestions are also welcome in the #game-suggestions channel.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Will there be a time limit on how long I can play the demo?[/p][p]A: The demo will be shut down after the Steam Next Fest event.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the demo! Don't forget to add Mecharashi to your wishlist! Join the conversation on Twitter and Discord to stay updated.[/p]

notes.title: ST Spotlight | XR - The Ultimate Classified Weapon
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vMzHfOd8wgI;full][/previewyoutube]
"XR"—a bold vision of future mech warfare, this ST, development code unknown, was created in collaboration with Obsidian and custom-built for a specific pilot whose identity remains unknown. According to its records, only one unit was ever produced.

The XR is equipped with a device called the "Mirror Core," which operates in conjunction with a Hub Processor in the cockpit and Mirror Imagers on the left and right arms to significantly enhance efficiency. The energy circulation management system in the body and legs also ensure the ST's long-term combat capability without resupply.
